name: Set the budget
deliverable: A budget spreadsheet we have both signed off, with a 10% contingency line
description: Rough numbers first, then real quotes. The contingency is not optional.

successCriteria.text: Total agreed by both of us
Every line backed by a quote or a real price

items.title: List everything we want
items.notes: Wish list first, cut later. Ended with 31 lines; cut to 22.

items.title: Price units at three suppliers
items.notes: Wren, a trade counter via the fitter, and a local joiner. Trade counter won on price.

items.title: Keep the layout or knock through to the dining room
items.notes: Knock through. Structural engineer confirmed the wall is not load-bearing (£180 visit).

items.title: Costs creep after demolition
items.notes: Mitigated with fixed-price quotes and the contingency line.
